### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=False
set -u
body=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8888/metrics 2>/dev/null) \
  || exit 3
printf '%s\n' "$body" | grep -E '^(vllm:|process_start_time_seconds )' \
  | grep -vE '_(bucket|created)\{' | head -n 1000 \
  | cut -c1-2000 || true
### call 2: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=False
set -u
body=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://192.0.2.10:11434/metrics 2>/dev/null) \
  || exit 3
printf '%s\n' "$body" | grep -E '^(vllm:|process_start_time_seconds )' \
  | grep -vE '_(bucket|created)\{' | head -n 1000 \
  | cut -c1-2000 || true
### call 3: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=False
set -u
if [ -z "$(journalctl -k -b -n 1 -q --no-pager 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo 'no kernel log of this boot is readable for the node user'
  exit 0
fi
journalctl -k -b -q --no-pager --no-hostname -o short-iso 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -E 'NVRM: Xid|fallen off the bus' | tail -n 500 \
  | cut -c1-2000 || true
### call 4: node=spark-1 timeout=330 check=False
set -u
body_file=$(mktemp)
cleanup() {
  test ! -e "$body_file" || unlink "$body_file"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
result=$(printf '%s' '{"model":"cluster-model","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Copy the following lines exactly, character for character, and output nothing else (no code fence):\nx = f(a[0])\ny = '"'"'$(b)'"'"'"}],"max_tokens":3000,"temperature":0}' | curl -sS -o "$body_file" \
  -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}' --max-time 300 \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- \
  http://127.0.0.1:8888/v1/chat/completions 2>/dev/null || true)
printf '%s\n' "RESULT=$result" \
  "BODY_B64=$(head -c 65536 "$body_file" | base64 -w0)"
### end
